description: What SPV lets this account request ("Solicitări"), read from the live form: the identities it may request for, and for one of them every document type with the fields it requires or accepts (year, month, registration_number, pui). Among a person's: Obligatii de plata (the statement of what is owed), Nota obligatiilor de plata, Istoric declaratii PF, Duplicat declaratie unica (year), Duplicat Recipisa (registration_number), Venituri Formular Banca, Interogari Banci, certificates. For a person's CNP, the types SPV makes only for a company (Notificare, and any it has refused that way before) are left out of types and listed under cui_only.

cif.description: The tax id to request for, one of `identities`; default the form's first (the account holder).
